name: GongIngestion
description: Syncs Gong call recordings by reading hourly sync-report tables from Slack channel C0AN85ZNGLS, deduping call_ids via a Data Table ledger, fetching full call data from BigQuery, upserting to Postgres gong_calls, and re-indexing into the Supabase gong vect

parameters.query:
WITH up AS (
  INSERT INTO public.gong_calls (call_id, scheduled_at, primary_user_id, meeting_system, data, summary, ingested_at)
  VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, '')::timestamptz, NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, ''), $5::jsonb,
          nullif(trim(both E' \n\t' from split_part(split_part($6, '## Brief', 2), E'\n## ', 1)), ''), now())
  ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE SET
    scheduled_at    = EXCLUDED.scheduled_at,
    primary_user_id = EXCLUDED.primary_user_id,
    meeting_system  = EXCLUDED.meeting_system,
    data            = EXCLUDED.data,
    summary         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.summary, gong_calls.summary),
    ingested_at     = now()
  RETURNING *
)
INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, summary, created_at)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.resource WHERE path = 'gong'::ltree),
       ('gong.c' || up.call_id)::ltree,
       'directory', up.call_id,
       NULLIF(up.data->>'title', ''), up.summary,
       COALESCE(up.scheduled_at, now())
FROM up
ON CONFLICT (path) DO UPDATE SET
  title   = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.title, resource.title),
  summary = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.summary, resource.summary)
RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Prepare Calls').item.json.call_id, $('Prepare Calls').item.json.scheduled_at, $('Prepare Calls').item.json.primary_user_id, $('Prepare Calls').item.json.meeting_system, JSON.stringify({ title: $('Prepare Calls').item.json.title, url: $('Prepare Calls').item.json.url, duration: $('Prepare Calls').item.json.duration, embed_url_base: $('Prepare Calls').item.json.embed_url_base, parties: $('Prepare Calls').item.json.parties, trackers: $('Prepare Calls').item.json.trackers }), $('Prepare Calls').item.json.summary_text] }}

nodes.name: UpsertGongCall
nodes.notes: Upserts gong_calls (incl. summary = Gong brief) and the gong.c<call_id> resource directory node. Makes new calls browseable via ls immediately.

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.resource (parent_id, path, kind, source_id, title, summary, created_at)
  SELECT d.id,
         (d.path::text || '.r' || g.id)::ltree,
         'gong_call', g.id::text,
         left(coalesce(g.metadata->>'title', 'gong call'), 80),
         d.summary,
         coalesce(nullif(g.metadata->>'scheduled_at', '')::timestamptz, now())
  FROM public.gong g
  JOIN public.resource d ON d.kind = 'directory' AND d.path = ('gong.c' || $1)::ltree
  WHERE g.metadata->>'call_id' = $1
  ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
del AS (
  DELETE FROM public.resource r
  WHERE r.kind = 'gong_call'
    AND r.path <@ ('gong.c' || $1)::ltree
    AND r.source_id::bigint NOT IN (SELECT id FROM public.gong WHERE metadata->>'call_id' = $1)
  RETURNING 1
),
led AS (
  INSERT INTO public.ingest_ledger (source, source_id, content_hash, chunk_version, embed_model, status, ingested_at)
  VALUES ('gong', $1, md5(coalesce($2, '')), 1, 'text-embedding-3-large', 'done', now())
  ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO UPDATE SET content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, status = 'done', error = NULL, ingested_at = now()
  RETURNING source_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS leaves_added,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM del) AS leaves_removed,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM led) AS ledger_written

nodes.name: SyncGongNodes
nodes.notes: Creates gong_call leaf resource nodes for this call’s vector rows (after embedding) and prunes leaves whose vector rows were deleted.

parameters.query:
SELECT j->>'call_id' AS call_id, j->>'title' AS title, j->>'parties' AS parties,
       j->>'sync_status' AS sync_status, j->>'sync_time' AS sync_time
FROM (SELECT $2::jsonb) AS t(j)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  -- DWN-65: skip calls that are done, in flight (pending), or failed 3 times.
  SELECT 1 FROM public.ingest_ledger
  WHERE source = 'gong' AND source_id = $1
    AND (status IN ('done', 'pending') OR attempts >= 3)
)

nodes.name: TidyLedger

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.ingest_ledger
SET status = 'error',
    error  = 'stale claim: no result within 6 hours (the run stopped, or the call returned no data)'
WHERE source = 'gong'
  AND status = 'pending'
  AND last_attempt_at < now() - interval '6 hours';

nodes.notes: DWN-65: a pending claim older than 6 hours has no result (the run stopped, or the call returned no data). Mark it as error, so the normal retry rule applies.

nodes.name: Limit
nodes.notes: DWN-65: at most N calls per run. Calls run one at a time, so N bounds the run time.

nodes.name: Claim

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.ingest_ledger AS l (source, source_id, content_hash, status, attempts, last_attempt_at)
VALUES ('gong', $1, '', 'pending', 1, now())
ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'pending', attempts = l.attempts + 1, last_attempt_at = now()
  WHERE l.status = 'error' AND l.attempts < 3
RETURNING l.source_id AS call_id, l.attempts

nodes.notes: DWN-65: claim the call in ingest_ledger before it runs (pending, attempts + 1). No row comes back when another run holds the call, when it is done, or when it failed 3 times. content_hash stays empty until SyncGongNodes writes it.

nodes.name: MarkFailed

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.ingest_ledger
SET status = 'error', error = left($2, 2000)
WHERE source = 'gong' AND source_id = $1 AND status = 'pending'
RETURNING source_id AS call_id, attempts, status

nodes.notes: DWN-65: the sub-workflow failed for this call. Store the error. The call is tried again on a later run until it has 3 attempts.
